{{Use British English|date=April 2018}}
The [[University of Oxford]] has three statutory professorships named after [[William of Wykeham]], who founded [[New College, Oxford|New College]].

==Logic==
The '''Wykeham Professorship in Logic''' was established in 1859, although it was not known as the Wykeham chair until later. Its first chair was Henry Wall.<ref name=oxfac>{{cite web |url=http://www.philosophy.ox.ac.uk/the_faculty/history_of_philosophy |title=History of Philosophy at Oxford: University Reform |work=Faculty of Philosophy, University of Oxford |accessdate=28 December 2010 |first=W.J. |last=Mander |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20161226001340/http://www.philosophy.ox.ac.uk/the_faculty/history_of_philosophy |archivedate=26 December 2016}}</ref>

===List of holders of post===

* Henry Wall,<ref name=oxfac/> 1849?–1870
* [[Thomas Fowler (academic)|Thomas Fowler]], 1873–1889
* [[John Cook Wilson]], 1889–1915
* [[Harold Henry Joachim]], 1919–1935
* [[Henry Habberley Price]], 1935–1959
* [[Alfred Jules Ayer]], 1959<ref name=oxfac/>–1978
* [[Michael Dummett]], 1979–1992
* [[David Wiggins]], 1993–2000
* [[Timothy Williamson]], 2000–2023
* [[Richard Pettigrew (philosopher)|Richard Pettigrew]], 2026–

==Ancient history==
The '''Wykeham Professorship of Ancient History''' was established in 1910.  It concentrates on [[Ancient Greece|Greek]] history to avoid possible duplication with the far older [[Camden Professorship of Ancient History]], which focuses primarily on [[Ancient Rome|Roman]] history.

===List of holders of post===
* [[J. L. Myres]], 1910–1939
* [[Theodore Wade-Gery]], 1939–1953
* [[Antony Andrewes]], 1953–1977
* [[George Forrest (Historian)|W. G. (George) Forrest]], 1977–1992
* [[Robert Parker (historian)|Robert Parker]], 1996–2016<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.new.ox.ac.uk/robert-parker |title=Fellows & Staff: Robert Parker |work=New College, Oxford |accessdate=15 January 2016 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160920220835/http://www.new.ox.ac.uk/robert-parker |archivedate=20 September 2016}}</ref>
* [[Nino Luraghi]], 2018–present

==Physics==
The Wykeham Professorship of Physics is the only endowed chair in the [[Rudolf Peierls Centre for Theoretical Physics]] at the [[University of Oxford]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ox.ac.uk/media/global/wwwoxacuk/localsites/currentvacancies/furtherparticularsforprofessorships/wd34-0311.pdf |title=Further Particulars For The Wykeham Professorship of Physics |work=University of Oxford |accessdate=20 April 2013}}</ref> This professorship is associated with [[New College, Oxford|New College]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Physics |work=New College, Oxford University |url=https://www.new.ox.ac.uk/node/676|accessdate=6 October 2018}}</ref>

===List of holders of post===
* [[John Sealy Townsend]], 1900–1941<ref name="physics.ox">{{cite web |url=http://www.physics.ox.ac.uk/history.asp?page=HistoryLong |title=Physics at the University of Oxford |work=Oxford University Department of Physics |accessdate=27 May 2017 |archive-date=10 May 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080510185449/http://www.physics.ox.ac.uk/history.asp?page=historylong |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Maurice Pryce]], 1946–1955<ref name="physics.ox"/>
* [[Willis Lamb]], 1957–1962<ref name="physics.ox"/>
* Sir [[Rudolf Peierls]], 1963–1974<ref name="physics.ox"/>
* Sir [[Roger Elliott (physicist)|Roger Elliott]], 1974–1988<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Elliott_Roger |title=Roger J. Elliott |work=[[Academia Europaea]] |accessdate=27 May 2017}}</ref>
* [[David Sherrington (physicist)|David Sherrington]], 1989–2008<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Sherrington_David |title=David Sherrington |work=Academia Europaea |accessdate=27 May 2017}}</ref>
* [[Shivaji Sondhi]], 2021–present.<ref>{{cite web|title=Eminent theoretical physicist joins Oxford|url=https://www.physics.ox.ac.uk/news/eminent-theoretical-physicist-joins-oxford|publisher=University of Oxford Department of Physics|accessdate=30 Aug 2021}}</ref>

===Tencent Chair of Theoretical Physics===
In February 2021 [[The Times]] reported that the Wykeham Professorship of Physics was to be renamed "Tencent-Wykeham Professorship of Physics" following a donation,<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thetimes.com/article/student-watchdog-vows-to-tackle-national-security-threat-from-university-links-to-china-c7jjzgks9 |title=Oxford renames 120-year-old Wykeham professorship for Tencent, Chinese software company |date=9 February 2021 |newspaper=[[The Times]]}}</ref> but the University later said the Wykeham Professorship of Physics will not be renamed; instead the current holder will also be given a separate post called "Tencent Chair of Theoretical Physics" to run concurrently with his Wykeham post.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.physics.ox.ac.uk/news/eminent-theoretical-physicist-joins-oxford |title=Eminent theoretical physicist joins Oxford |date=26 August 2021 |publisher=University of Oxford Department of Physics |quote=The Department of Physics is delighted to confirm the appointment of Professor Shivaji Sondhi to the University’s Wykeham Professorship of Physics, a Leverhulme International Professorship, and the Tencent Chair of Theoretical Physics.}}</ref>
